changes: Threaded the resolved gitRoot (gitCwd) into doctor --repair (repairStoryMetadataAllowlist, doctor.ts) and lint change-scoping (resolveChangedFiles + defaultChangedFilesReader in validate-lint.ts, plus call sites in verifier.ts:630 and review-preflight.ts:334), and removed a duplicate comment. Fixes two combination-review stacking gaps where parallel stories' new git calls bypassed the B-2856/B-1637 gitRoot resolution.
usage: On a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot != gitRoot), run `lattice doctor --repair` to install the metadata-protection allowlist, and `lattice validate --lint --story=B-xxx` to scope lint to changed packages. No new flags; existing commands now behave correctly on wrapper-root layouts.
expectedOutcome: doctor --repair installs the allowlist on wrapper-root (previously: 'fatal: not a git repository' and a silent no-op); lint change-scope runs git diff from the gitRoot on wrapper-root (previously: silent fallback to full recursive tsc).
actualTranscript: node dist/tasks/story-metadata-protection-smoke.js -> 12 checks pass exit 0 (real temp-git wrapper-root fixture asserts repairWrote:true + adversarial revert proof). node dist/tasks/validate-lint-change-scope-smoke.js -> pass exit 0 (DI seam asserts threaded gitCwd + rebase). lattice validate --story=B-0740 -> ALL PASS, verification coverage 6/6.
outcomeDiff: Expected == actual: wrapper-root repair installs the allowlist; lint change-scope rebases gitRoot-relative paths correctly; plain repos byte-identical (gitCwd==projectRoot identity); adversarial revert proofs confirm the tests are not tautological.
limitations: none — both gaps fixed and real-machine tested; both fixes fail-safe (fall back to root when no gitRoot resolves, so plain repos are unchanged).
pitfalls: The fixes consume the existing resolvers (resolveDoctorGitCwd / resolveGitCwd); any FUTURE new git invocation added to doctor.ts or the lint change-scope path must also thread gitCwd, or it will re-introduce the wrapper-root gap this story closed.
